SELECT c.relname AS table_name, obj_description(c.oid) AS table_comment FROM pg_class c LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON n.oid = c.relnamespace WHERE c.relkind = 'r' AND n.nspname = 'public' AND c.relname NOT LIKE 'pg_%' AND c.relname NOT LIKE 'sql_%' AND c.relname NOT IN (SELECT table_name FROM gen_table)
AND c.relname LIKE CONCAT('%', #{tableName}, '%')
ORDER BY c.relname

SELECT a.attname AS column_name, col_description(a.attrelid, a.attnum) AS column_comment, format_type(a.atttypid, a.atttypmod) AS column_type, CASE WHEN a.attnotnull THEN 'NO' ELSE 'YES' END AS is_nullable, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM pg_constraint con WHERE con.conrelid = a.attrelid AND a.attnum = ANY(con.conkey) AND con.contype = 'p' ) THEN 'PRI' ELSE '' END AS column_key, pg_get_expr(d.adbin, d.adrelid) AS column_default, a.attnum AS ordinal_position FROM pg_attribute a LEFT JOIN pg_attrdef d ON a.attrelid = d.adrelid AND a.attnum = d.adnum LEFT JOIN pg_class c ON a.attrelid = c.oid LEFT JOIN pg_namespace n ON c.relnamespace = n.oid WHERE c.relname = #{tableName} AND n.nspname = 'public' AND a.attnum > 0 AND NOT a.attisdropped ORDER BY a.attnum
